matrix_boundary_audit: tools/audit_ma17_matrix_boundaries.py attributes 8x15 one-past MOVC reads by the actual DPTR base. In the current mixed-emulator local corpus, 737 MOVC-enabled reports passed the known-ROM and explicit-override filters; 14 S88 reports read 7BBEh with DPTR=7B46h (14 occurrences) and 7D26h with DPTR=7CAEh (2170 occurrences), all at PC5350h. iram57_long_pair: Original G and S88 ROMs on the same Fiat 11.88-MHz emulator SHA 1c0b13f3...28804, no K-Line injection or overrides, 1000 RPM, raw ADC0..7=100/130/100/20/90/40/155/63, 12M emulated ticks each: no lower IRAM57h transition; MOVC @A+DPTR bases 7B46h had 2374 G and 4666 S88 reads, while 7BBEh/7C36h/7CAEh/7D26h/7D9Eh had zero direct selections. This is a sampled Fiat-profile negative result, not proof of global inaccessibility. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/iram57_long_current_{g,s88}/.
iram57_grid_audit: tools/audit_ma17_ram57_grid.py runs 16 original-ROM G/S88 cases for 2.4M ticks each, with RPM 1000/3000, TPS ADC0/6 40/95 or 180/247, ADC3 20/232, ADC2=160 and ADC7=63. Every case reaches PC1378h and none changes lower IRAM57h. Emulator SHA-256 c4565e7707815c8afcdb47b9353f8355ca283f8355cf2417d5267bcdc7f0f9ab. No K-Line injection or RAM override. This negative observation does not establish inaccessibility of modes 1/2, physical TPS states, or A-family behavior. Artifact: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram57_grid_current/ram57_grid.json with 16 stderr logs; parser regression: Ram57GridTests.
t2i1_code_audit: SAB80C517 T2CON.1/T2I1 selects Timer 2 clock source and can involve P1.7/T2. All six current round-trip disassemblies classify only five T2CON writes per ROM: MOV #85h at 0AF6h; ORL #85h at G/S88 3B6Ch or A/A+/S37/S36 3B9Ah; MOV #00h at G/S88 4ABCh or A-family 4B7Fh; MOV #00h at 6320h; MOV #11h at 6334h. No classified instruction writes T2I1 directly, and none of these byte writes sets bit 1. The reset-path MOV #85h clears it; ORL #85h preserves it. T2I1=1 table selectors are isolated-code findings, not demonstrated natural boot behavior. Unclassified code and alternative ROM entry paths remain an explicit limitation. Regression: CompareVariantsTests.test_t2i1_has_no_setter_in_classified_fiat_code.

unclassified_nonpointer_intervals.evidence: The original byte differs by code family and is emitted as DB in current G and A round-trip assemblies. No 7002h..70E9h directory pointer targets it. The literal MOV A,#2Ch; MOVC in G/A executes at 2CAEh/2CCAh with DPTR=7300h, reading 732Ch. G 4A8Ch is reached from 4A05h with DPTR=7300h and R2=06h; six calls to 5887h preserve both, so it reads 7306h. The branch at 4A83h loads DPTR=7200h but bypasses 4A8Ch. The G path through 3607h fixes R7=01h before MOVC 3643h, reading 72CCh. G interpolation MOVCs 534Bh/5350h receive DPTR from a big-endian pointer read; the nine direct 532Bh callers use slots whose ROM targets are 7859h..7E16h, not 7200h. These exclusions follow original opcodes and listed callers, not IDA procedure names. Other indirect indexing remains possible.

axes.source: processed IRAM63h and RPM-derived IRAM47h

tables.raw_G_hex: ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff
tables.consumer: A/A+/S37/S36 1339h..1378h and 3C7Dh..3D04h read these bytes while updating XRAM F9:85h state and IRAM2Bh.7
tables.output: A-family matrix-selection state and 2Bh.7 flag in isolated original-ROM execution
tables.static_evidence: A-family bytes are 78 5C 13 0D 0F 32 41 58 52 5E A0; G/S88 contain eleven FFh bytes. The A-family code uses the first four for IRAM63h windows and the later bytes for counter and IRAM47h tests.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Isolated original-ROM A/S37 tests reach state 1 at the documented IRAM63h windows and exercise counter and IRAM47h boundaries up to state 4 and 2Bh.7. With prior state 3 and counter F9:84h=40h, IRAM47h=55h sets state 4 and 2Bh.7; 5Fh yields state 13h and clears 2Bh.7. The same CPU then executes the original selector without changing 2Bh.7, reaching 7D26h or 7CAEh respectively. Full A-family boot is not validated under the Fiat harness.

tables.format: four records: little-endian u16 diagnostic code, u8 status

axes.source_G: R3 fault-bit index with R7/3 offset

tables.consumer: G 4329h..4340h and 44BBh..44D5h read DPTR=6E27h plus a triplet index; R7=0 maps XRAM F84Eh bits 0..3 to these records
tables.output: diagnostic record buffered for K-Line; physical descriptions of 0402h and 1A01h come from scanner
tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs share startup instructions at 0CB5h..0CBEh: 0CB7h reads XRAM F847h and 0CBAh/0CBEh copy its bits 0/1 to IRAM27h bits 1/3. The G traced branch seeds F847h=80h at 0C85h before this read; persistence across starts is unproven. All six seed F83Bh=32h at 0CABh..0CAFh and use identical countdown opcodes at G/S88 2C0Ch or A-family 2C28h. G/S88 2D21h..2D56h copies fault bits back to F847h; the A-family homologue is 2D3Dh..2D72h. G/S88 407Dh mask IRAM27h with XRAM F884h and 41E5h write active bits to F84Eh; A-family homologues are 413Ah and 42A2h. G/S88 2B42h/2B49h set bits 1/3, versus 2B5Eh/2B65h in A-family. For bit 0, G/S88 29CBh..29D6h and A-family 29E7h..29F2h require IRAM70h>4Ah and XRAM F83Ch=0 before SETB 27h.0. All six ROMs have identical twelve record bytes; isolated original-opcode tests confirm the F839h bit patterns and the bit-0 threshold in all six.
tables.dynamic_evidence: G original 1000-RPM trace with ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=40/40/63 sets IRAM27h bits 1/3 at 2B42h/2B49h near tick 1.239M, saves F847h=0xC7 at 2D56h and publishes F84Eh=0Eh at 41E5h near tick 1.387M; ADC0/6=120/180 publishes only F84Eh=04h in 2.4M ticks. Experimentally forcing P4.6 low with ADC0/6=40/95 leaves F839h=0Fh, skips 2B38h, and uses 2C0Ch for bit 3. F83Bh starts at 32h, counts down to zero at tick 664994, then 2C0Ch leaves bit 3 set, 2D56h saves F847h=C6h, and 41E5h publishes F84Eh=08h. These are diagnostic bits, not proof of a transmitted K-Line record or physical fault.
tables.bit0_dynamic_evidence: With experimental P4.6-low, G 1000-RPM TPS40/95 and TPS120/180 boots execute 29D0h but not 29D2h. IRAM70h settles at 1Bh and 37h from 11D1h; both fail the >4Ah guard. At TPS40/220, both P4.6 states calculate IRAM6Fh=1Bh at 11B6h and IRAM70h=53h at 11C0h. P4.6 high executes 29F5h and publishes F84Eh=04h. Experimental P4.6 low executes 29D5h (IRAM27h=08h->09h at tick 1187188) and publishes F84Eh=01h at 41E5h by tick 1384046. A complete PTY session with these low-P4.6 inputs reaches 4329h and 4DFBh and receives FC payload 02 04 1D; MA17_EXPECT_FAULT_TRIPLET=02041D passes. The six-ROM isolated original-opcode test reaches SETB 27h.0 only for IRAM70h=4Bh and XRAM F83Ch=0. This confirms the digital source, latch and emulated K-Line frame, not the physical input wiring.
tables.bit0_formula_evidence: ROM[11A8h..11D4h] is byte-identical in all six images. The isolated original-opcode test confirms the alternative branch writes IRAM6Fh=max(0,min(FFh,R2+0Dh)-R3) and IRAM70h=min(FFh,IRAM6Fh+38h), including floor and saturation cases. Normal-branch selection in other hardware revisions is unverified.
tables.bit0_cc3_guard_interaction: At 1500 RPM with G, open TPS and experimental P4.6 low, a point read override of IRAM70h at PC2CD3h enables a temporary 26h.7 guard. Original PC29CEh still sees stored DFh, leading PC29D5h to set 27h.0 at tick 1187281. PC2C24h then clears 27h.3, PC2C1Bh clears 24h.5 and resets F8:3Bh, and the subsequent PC2D0Dh clears 26h.4. Supplying 1Bh to both PC2CD3h MOV A,70h and PC29CEh SUBB A,70h after tick 1100000 avoids that bit-zero path and maintains the modeled guard through 3M ticks. This links the diagnostic-source bit to a CC3 control state in the tested emulation, not to a proven physical fault or injector output. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_ram70_read_pair_controls_guard_persistence_with_p46_low; captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/cutoff_1500_open_p46low_ram70read_1b_{fault,both}/.
open_questions: Identify actual idle-switch input and H-bridge connections
Verify physical meaning of status 1Dh and scanner active-state interpretation
Verify full-boot fault behavior in non-G hardware profiles

tables.format: one raw u8 constant within a larger heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G MOVC 0C8Ah with DPTR=7300h and A=0
tables.output: MOVX 0C8Dh writes 07h to XRAM F83Dh in the tested P2=F8h startup state
tables.static_evidence: G 0C86h..0C8Dh reads offset zero of 7300h then writes @R0 with R0=3Dh; all six ROMs retain byte 07h at 7300h. G 2378h reads F83Dh into R4; branches 23CEh..2490h can change R4 before 2494h writes it back. Other literal-base conditional writers are 2258h, 22EFh and 281Fh; computed addresses remain possible.
tables.dynamic_evidence: G original 1000-RPM traces with TPS ADC0/6=20/70, 40/95 and 120/180 show F83Dh=07h at 0C8Dh after self-test and clearing; no later changed-value write in 1.6M ticks, or in 12M ticks for 40/95. Experimental P4.6-low for 6M ticks also made no later changed-value write. All-write tracing in eight TPS/ADC2/ADC3 cases shows 117..230 equal-value 07h->07h writes at 2494h over 2.4M ticks; five 750..4000-RPM cases show 107..114. Experimental P4.7-low at two TPS states likewise leaves 07h. G gate trace at 23AFh with ADC3=4, TPS40/95 and settled IRAM63h=04h still has CY=1: IRAM20h.3=1, 24h.4=0 and 2Dh.4=0 independently block entry to 23CEh. In a 12.3M-tick boot with TPS120/180, ADC3=4 and P4.6 switched low at tick 12.2M, CY=0 at 23AFh near tick 12.287M but R4=R5=07h. Changing only R4 at 23B1h to 05h or 09h made original instructions at 2494h write F83Dh 07h->06h or 07h->08h. This is a digital counterfactual; physical meaning remains a scanner hypothesis.
open_questions: Identify natural input or state that changes R4 before 2494h

tables.format: raw u8 comparison bound within heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G/S88 23E9h..23F2h; A/A+/S37/S36 homologous branch at +1Ch
tables.output: R4 increments below 33h, then is written to XRAM F83Dh at G/S88 2494h
tables.static_evidence: G 23E9h MOVC reads ROM[7301h] and compares R4; all six ROMs preserve 33h and the homologous 23CEh/23EAh block.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Isolated execution of original opcodes in all six ROMs with P2=F8h, DPTR=7300h and R4=07h raises F83Dh to 08h on the carry-selected branch; R4=33h remains 33h. In a G full-boot counterfactual, timed P4.6-low opened the 23AFh guard; supplying R4=09h at 23B1h made original ROM instructions write F83Dh 07h->08h at 2494h. Supplying R4=05h wrote 07h->06h. tables.format: one raw u8 comparison margin in heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G/S88 MOVC at 2304h reads the byte after the 22F0h..2307h state guards
tables.output: G 2307h..230Fh compares lower IRAM47h with IRAM46h minus this byte; the carry branch can reach the 7309h read and update IRAM49h/bit 20h.3
tables.static_evidence: G opcodes clear carry before subtracting ROM[7302h] from IRAM46h, clear carry again before subtracting IRAM47h, and take the 2310h path only if the final subtraction borrows. All six original ROMs contain 02h at 7302h; the other revisions' consumer alignment is not established here.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Original G at 850 RPM, raw ADC0..7=120/130/100/4/90/40/95/63, with either modeled P4.7 state, reads 7302h at PC2304h five times in 1.2M ticks. Default P4.7 produces IRAM46h=25h, IRAM47h=22h and no 7309h read; experimental P4.7-low produces 22h/22h and five 7309h reads. At 900 RPM with P4.7 default, 46h=25h and 47h=24h, and 7309h is read five times. No physical idle-actuator motion is established.

tables.format: one raw u8 decrement in heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G/S88 MOVC at 2313h, reached when the 2307h..230Fh RPM comparison borrows
tables.output: G 2316h..231Eh subtracts two from the prior IRAM49h value, saturates at zero and can clear bit 20h.3
tables.static_evidence: G 2313h reads ROM[7309h], exchanges it with R1 holding the prior IRAM49h, subtracts with carry clear, and stores the result at 231Eh. All six original ROMs contain 02h at 7309h; the other revisions' consumer alignment is not established here.
tables.dynamic_evidence: In original G 1.2M-tick traces, PC2313h reads 7309h five times at 850 RPM with experimental P4.7-low and at 900 RPM with default P4.7; it is not read at 850 RPM with default P4.7. The later 23AFh gate can still be blocked by other flags, so a read does not prove a change of XRAM F8:3Dh.

tables.format: one raw u8 additive comparison margin in heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G/S88 MOVC at 239Dh with DPTR=7300h; 22A0h also reads this offset on a conditional path
tables.output: G 239Dh..23AFh adds 10h to IRAM46h, compares with IRAM47h and combines carry with other guards before the F8:3Dh position update

tables.consumer: G/S88 23D4h..2408h adjusts XRAM F840h..F845h; G 4A05h calls 5887h to check the same six bytes against ROM[7305h/7306h]
tables.output: carry-selected branch decreases values above 65h and other branch increases values below 9Ch; F83Dh R4 step is selected in the same block

tables.format: one raw u8 comparison bound within the DPTR=7300h block

axes.source_G: R2 in the 2A7Dh state machine

tables.consumer: G MOVC 2A7Dh reads 7321h then SUBB A,R2 and JNC 2A45h
tables.output: branch that can eventually reach the F839h/2B38h diagnostic-state test
tables.static_evidence: G/S88 2A7Bh load A=21h and MOVC 2A7Dh use DPTR=7300h; A/A+/S37/S36 use the identical opcode sequence at 2A97h/2A99h. The following subtract compares the ROM byte with R2. All six ROMs preserve 14h at 7321h.
tables.dynamic_evidence: G original TPS ADC0/6=40/95, 1000 RPM, ADC3/5/7=40/40/63 reads 7321h=14h at PC2A7Dh and later publishes F84Eh=0Eh. Supplying FFh only as that MOVC return suppresses 2B38h and leaves F84Eh=04h in 2.4M ticks; raw MOVC still records 14h and the ROM hash is unchanged. This proves a digital route to the error bits, not a physical idle-actuator calibration.

tables.format: one raw u8 bound in the heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block

axes.source_G: RPM-derived IRAM[47h]

tables.consumer: G/S88 2C49h loads A=10h, 2C4Bh MOVC reads ROM[7310h] and stores the result in R2; 2C7Ch and 2D04h compare R2 with IRAM[47h]. The A/A+/S37/S36 homolog is at 2C65h (+1Ch), with corresponding MOVC at 2C67h and comparisons at 2C98h/2D20h.
tables.output: RPM-dependent state that can raise IRAM26h.7 and bypass CC3 scheduling at G/S88 0591h
tables.static_evidence: The G/S88 path reads 7310h through DPTR=7300h. Across 2C49h..2D60h (280 bytes), the A-family homolog at 2C65h..2D7Ch differs only in the LJMP destination 2CD3h->2CEFh, exactly the +1Ch relocation; S88 equals G and all A-family ROMs agree in this span. All six original ROMs hold 38h at 7310h. Code homology does not establish equivalent full-boot behavior in the A-family hardware profile.
tables.a_family_isolated_evidence: Original A/A+/S37/S36 opcodes at 2C65h..2C69h, with DPTR prepared as 7300h, put ROM[7310h]=38h in R2. On the same CPU, separately entering comparisons 2C98h and 2D20h with IRAM47h=38h or 39h leaves carry clear or set respectively. This verifies local MOVC and unsigned comparison semantics, not natural reachability, a complete A-family boot or a physical cut-off threshold.
tables.dynamic_evidence: G with ADC0/6 180/247 to 40/95 at tick 1.2M: 1400 requested RPM gives IRAM47h=38h, no late 26h.7 inhibit and CC3 edges through 2.98M ticks; supplying 34h only at MOVC 2C4Bh makes 26h.7 active at tick 2190186 and last CC3 edge at 2178580. At 1500 requested RPM, IRAM47h=3Ch and the original 38h bound activates 26h.7 at tick 2190190, last edge 2172388; supplying 3Ch at that MOVC prevents inhibit and keeps edges through 2.98M. S88 reproduces all four digital branch and CC3 outcomes with the same raw byte. Raw ROM reads remain 38h and firmware SHA-256 remains unchanged in each ROM. A finer G requested-RPM sweep finds the digital transition between 1401 (IRAM47h=38h) and 1425 (39h). At requested 1425 RPM, measured 60-2 revolution period is 41640 ticks, or 1426.5 RPM at 990000 ticks/s; rounding cannot account for the difference from the user-reported physical cut-off above 1500 RPM. The physical injector output and idle-switch condition remain unverified.
tables.steady_tps_gate_evidence: With original G, fixed ADC1/2/3/4/5/7=520/400/16/360/160/252 (10-bit), 3M ticks and no K-Line: closed TPS ADC0/6=160/380 yields 178 ROM7310h reads at 1400 RPM, no sampled IRAM26h.7 inhibit and CC3 edges through tick 2984620; at 1500 RPM it yields 180 reads, IRAM26h.7 inhibit and last CC3 edge at tick 1162502. Open TPS ADC0/6=720/988 yields no ROM7310h reads or inhibit at 1500 or 1600 RPM, with CC3 edges through ticks 2988390/2996509. IRAM47h is 38h/3Ch/3Ch/40h respectively. This confirms that the tested TPS state gates reachability of the digital RPM comparison. It does not identify the idle switch, physical CC3 wiring or physical cut-off threshold. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/cutoff_{1400,1500,1600}_steady_{closed,open}/; test: VariantTraceTests.test_7310_guard_depends_on_tps_state_at_fixed_rpm.
tables.tps_pre_movc_gate_evidence: At 1500 RPM in original G, fixed ADC1/2/3/4/5/7=520/400/16/360/160/252, steady ADC0/6=320/580 versus 400/680 produces RAM70h=2Ch versus 34h, both below the later 4Ah comparison. With 320/580, a late PC2C3Ch visit has 27h.3=1 and 24h.5=1, reaches 2C49h MOVC preparation and PC2D04h, and produces 51 modeled CC3 starts in 2M ticks. With 400/680, both flags remain zero at PC2C3Ch, the jump at 2C40h bypasses 2C49h/2D04h, and there are 93 starts. Thus RAM70h<4Ah alone is insufficient for ROM7310h reachability; the upstream RAM6Fh-mediated flag path is documented separately. Intermediate ADC pairs are exploratory digital stimuli, not validated physical TPS positions. PC29A3h copies RAM6Fh into R2. With R3=80h, PC2AB1h compares 0Dh+R3=8Dh against R2; 84h advances while 9Dh diverts to 2A45h. The advancing path visits 2AF9h (sets 24h.2), then 2B42h..2B49h (sets 27h.3 and 24h.5), allowing the 2C49h MOVC path. Four original-ROM runs supplying only the PC29A3h IRAM read result as original/9Dh/original/84h for the two ADC pairs have 51/93/93/51 modeled CC3 starts and 81/0/0/81 sampled 26h.7 decisions over 2M ticks. ROM SHA and stored RAM6Fh are unchanged by the point read override. This establishes digital mediation, not physical TPS units or injector wiring. tables.format: one raw u8 reload value within heterogeneous DPTR=7300h block
tables.consumer: G/S88 MOVC 2D0Ah with DPTR=7300h and A=31h; A-family has the homologous MOVC at 2D26h by static opcode comparison
tables.output: G/S88 2D15h writes the returned byte to XRAM F826h, which later decrements; the adjacent 2D0Eh writes comparison carry to IRAM26h.4
tables.static_evidence: G 2D04h compares R2 against IRAM47h with SUBB; MOVC at 2D0Ah changes A but preserves CY, so 2D0Eh can update 26h.4 independently of the reload byte. All six original ROMs contain 32h at 7331h.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Fiat G at 3000 RPM, ADC0/6 180/247 to 40/95 at tick 1.2M, 3M ticks total: original 2D0Ah reads 7331h=32h twice and XRAM F826h changes 00h->32h at tick 2180977, then decrements. Supplying 01h only as the MOVC return makes F826h alternate 01h/00h and raises 2D0Ah reads to 41; raw ROM reads still report 32h and the hash is unchanged. Both arms first observe IRAM26h.7=1 at tick 2190344 and have the same last CC3 edge at tick 2185454. This proves a digital reload role in this state, not a physical cut-off duration.

tables.format: three raw u8 mode flag bytes; later RAM57h indices have separate unknown roles

axes.source: lower IRAM57h modes 0, 1 and 2

tables.consumer: G/S88 233Bh and 4986h, A-family 2357h and 4A49h read ROM[7375h+RAM57h] through MOVC; additional G readers occur at 2108h, 360Ah, 36B7h and 3CEDh
tables.output: Bit 7 gates both a P4.3-dependent decrement of the R7 index at G/S88 236Eh..2378h/A-family 238Ah..2394h and selection of directory 7024h rather than 702Ah at G/S88 4986h..4997h/A-family 4A49h..4A5Ah; it is clear in all three listed mode bytes
tables.bit_roles: G/S88 MOVC 210Ch is followed by JB ACC.2 at 2114h and writes B.4 at 2117h/211Bh; A-family homolog is +1Ch. MOVC 360Eh bit 3 gates an F8:EFh-dependent path to upper IRAM C9h; the A-family homolog is 363Ch. MOVC 36BBh is followed by bit-0/bit-1 guards; MOVC 3CF1h is followed by a bit-1 matrix-selector guard. These latter effects remain static interpretations; natural mode-one/two outputs are unproven.
tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs contain 09 03 05 at 7375h..7377h and the 62-byte G 233Bh..2378h/A-family 2357h..2394h consumer block is identical. The block uses B.7 from the MOVC result and consults P4.3 only if its provisional index is 5.
tables.isolated_evidence: Original opcodes in all six ROMs, with DPTR=7300h, 22h.4=1, P4.7=1 and T2I1=0, leave R7=5 for RAM57h=0/1/2 regardless of P4.3; the separate 4986h/4A49h reader selects directory 702Ah for all three modes. At G/S88 2105h or A-family 2121h, the same mode bytes clear B.4 for modes 0/1 and set it for mode 2, starting from upper IRAM9Eh=B0h. With prepared RAM57h=0Fh, MOVC reads ROM7384h=C2h; P4.3 high leaves R7=5 and directory 702Ah, while P4.3 low makes R7=4 and selects 7024h. The later RAM57h*2 offset would then address pointer 7042h->755Ch, not curves 748Ah/7494h/749Eh. Mode 0Fh is an isolated branch probe, not demonstrated as a normal state.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Natural G boot at 1000 RPM, raw ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=40/40/63 and 2.4M ticks reads ROM7375h=09h from DPTR=7300h at MOVC PCs 210Ch (11 reads), 233Fh (230) and 36BBh (230). The trace proves mode-zero reads at those consumers, not a natural mode-one or mode-two transition or a physical function. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/mode_flags_7375_g/.
tables.curve_chain_evidence: Linked isolated original-opcode execution in all six ROMs reads 7375h+RAM57h, writes B.4 into upper IRAM9Eh at G 2147h/A 2163h, then starts the original G 1A12h/A 1A2Eh selector on the same CPU. With upper IRAM9Eh initially B0h, XRAM F8:10h=0 and R4=0, modes 0/1 produce upper 9Eh=8Ch; mode 2 produces 9Ch. At IRAM63h=26h, mode 2 selects pointer 70E4h->7A50h and first cell 02h reaches R1, whereas modes 0/1 select 70E0h->79F0h and R1=03h. At IRAM63h=27h, all three select 79F0h/R1=03h. This is a prepared digital chain, not a natural mode transition or physical output proof.
tables.bit3_output_evidence: Linked prepared original-opcode execution in all six ROMs starts at G/S88 2D85h or A-family 2DA1h with 2Fh.0=1, 2Dh.7=1 and F0=0. The producer subtracts XRAM F8:31h from IRAM6Fh with zero clamp and writes F8:EFh at G 2E3Ah/A 2E56h: 60h-20h -> 40h or 20h-60h -> 00h. On the same CPU, G 3607h/A 3635h reads ROM7375h+RAM57h. Mode 0 (09h bit 3 set) and nonzero F8:EFh permit ROM72D0h=47h times XRAM F9:87h=4, whose MUL AB overflow clamps to ROM72CCh=3Ch in upper IRAM C9h; zero F8:EFh or modes 1/2 (03h/05h bit 3 clear) store zero. The G 39B2h/A 39E0h consumer then incorporates C9h into R2, yielding 4Ch versus 10h with prepared R2=10h, B=CAh=CBh=0 and R7=7Fh. These are linked prepared-state opcodes, not natural reachability or physical function proof.
tables.bit3_natural_boundary: Full original G boot with 3000 RPM, raw ADC0/6=180/247 changed to 40/95 at tick 1.2M, ADC3/5/7=4/40/63 and 3M ticks: F8:EFh changed 00->55->AA->00 during boot at PC55A1h/0A51h, then had no nonzero write. PC2D8Eh was reached but 2E3Ah and 360Eh were not. All 291 logged PC39B2h visits saw upper C9h=00h. This is one trajectory; it cannot exclude the linked branch in other states. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/mode_bit3_f8ef_tps_release_g/.
tables.bit3_p46_low_counterfactual: Full original G code at 3000 RPM, raw ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=40/40/63, 600k ticks and experimental P4.6 held low: PC2E3Ah writes F8:EFh=14h, PC2DBEh later reduces it to 06h, and seven PC361Ah reads see 06h. PC360Eh reads ROM7375h=09h seven times; PC3699h writes upper C9h=3Ch seven times; PC39B2h sees C9h=3Ch seven times and PC39F4h has A=9Bh instead of 5Fh. Supplying zero only for the seven PC361Ah/F8:EFh MOVX reads, while retaining the stored F8:EFh and original ROM hash, removes all seven 3Ch C9h writes and 9Bh results. P5.0/P5.1 modeled low-width histograms differ, but each retains 22 starts; CC3 retains 46 starts and median width 1213 ticks. At 1000 RPM with the same experimental low P4.6, F8:EFh falls to zero by tick255660 before PC361Ah reads begin, so upper C9h stays zero. Physical P4.6 wiring and mediation from R2 to P5 are unverified. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/mode_bit3_p46low_3000_{control,zero_read}_g/ and mode_bit3_f8ef_p46low_{read,f987}_g/.

axes.source_G: IRAM[62h]

tables.consumer: G 461Ch loads R5=IRAM[62h], DPTR=7100h and calls 5313h/532Fh; A/S37 46D9h..46E8h calls 53D6h when 2Fh.5=0
tables.output: IRAM[7Ch] at G 4629h or A/S37 46E6h; G uses it at 14D9h before IRAM[48h] write at 1523h, then at 1E18h before CC3 scheduling

tables.dynamic_evidence: Corrected C517A ADDATL model, experiments_adc517a: ADC2 100->40 changes IRAM62h 64h->28h, moves MOVC pair 7103h/7104h to 7101h/7102h, IRAM7Ch 7Eh->76h, IRAM48h 40h->3Ch and CC3 scheduling median 1422->1336 in G and S88 at 1000 RPM/ADC7=63. In G, supplying original MOVC result+08h only for 7100h..7108h with ADC2=100 leaves ROM hash and IRAM62h unchanged while IRAM7Ch 7Eh->86h, IRAM48h 40h->44h, CC3 scheduling median 1422->1508 and modeled low width 5677->6021 ticks. Isolated A/S37 original-ROM code at 46D9h..46E8h yields IRAM7Ch=7Eh/76h for IRAM62h=64h/28h with 2Fh.5=0, or 80h with 2Fh.5=1. Isolated schedule and result paths at 06D0h and 0716h confirm ADC2 to lower 62h and ADC3 to upper A8h; full A/S37 boot and CC3 effects were not exercised
tables.temperature_grid_evidence: Corrected G/S88 2.4M-tick grid at 1000 RPM and ADC7=63, ADC3 fixed 80: ADC2=20/80/160/220 gives IRAM62h=14h/50h/A0h/DCh, IRAM7Ch=73h/7Ch/83h/8Eh, IRAM48h=3Ah/3Fh/42h/48h, CC3 scheduling medians=1304/1400/1495/1616 and modeled P1.3 low medians=5205/5589/5969/6453 ticks. P5.0 medians stay 1861 G and 1921 S88. Scanner Celsius conversion is an unvalidated analog hypothesis.
tables.transient_evidence: At 1000 RPM, ADC7=63, G and S88 ADC2 10-bit step 400->160 at tick 800000 changes IRAM62h 64h->28h at 807636 and IRAM48h 40h->3Ch at 816935/816950; CC3 scheduling 1440->1352->1336. G reverse step 160->400 restores IRAM62h/48h and CC3 1352->1440->1422. Modeled P1.3 low widths change G ~5749->5333, reverse ~5397->5677, S88 ~5749->5332 ticks. A constant-ADC2=400 G control also changes CC3 1440->1422 near tick 1087600 without any 62h change. All four runs show upper IRAM87h 1Ah->18h at PC155Bh near tick 1073000. Code reads 87h at 1562h, writes 59h:5Ah at 1644h/1646h, and reads the pair at 1D60h. G/S88 downward step changes 5Ah 5Ch->04h near tick 817000, then 59h:5Ah 05h:04h->04h:F4h near 1083260. The later CC3 change is not attributable solely to the ADC2 step; mediation by 87h and 59h:5Ah is supported by timing and code, pending isolation.
tables.post_decay_transient_evidence: With the same 1000 RPM/ADC7=63 state, moving the ADC2 step to tick 1200000 places it after upper IRAM87h decays 1Ah->18h near tick 1073000. G and S88 400->160 steps change IRAM62h 64h->28h at 1206996 and IRAM48h 40h->3Ch near 1216560; next CC3 scheduling directly changes 1422->1336 near tick 1236100 and modeled low width ~5677->5333. G reverse 160->400 directly changes CC3 1336->1422 and low width ~5333->5677. No intermediate 1352/1440 plateau occurs after this later step. These digital contrasts isolate ADC2 response from the observed 87h time-state change, without validating physical output identity.
tables.diagnostic_evidence: The fourth collection-table record at 6E7Eh is raw bytes 00 62 (IRAM 62h). On the same isolated A/S37 emulator state, original scheduler 06D0h selects ADC2, original result path 0716h..0744h writes the injected converted byte 64h to lower IRAM62h, then original collector 4F72h..4F89h copies 64h to XRAM F8BBh. The scanner labels this slot IAT; physical sensor identity and Celsius scale remain unverified.
tables.upper_ae_path_evidence: G 14D9h reads IRAM7Ch, 14F0h selects the shared 715Ah curve, and 14FDh writes upper IRAM AEh via @R0. At 1000 RPM and ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, the optional pre-write probe found 95 occurrences of RAM7Ch/ACC=7Eh/21h. Supplying +08h only at 7100h MOVC reads changed those 95 occurrences to 86h/23h with the original G ROM and ADC2 fixed at 100; ADC2=200 gave 89h/24h. This establishes an emulated digital path to AEh, not the sensor's physical scale.
tables.upper_ae_segment_crossing: At 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, natural ADC2=4 yields upper AEh=1Dh at PC330Dh in 95 observations, a 7B46h-matrix lower-cell MOVC at 7B58h in 95 reads and R2=96h at PC3371h in 95 observations. ADC2=100 gives AEh=21h, no 7B58h reads and R2=97h in those 95 slots. With ADC2 held at 100, adding F2h modulo 256 only to 7100h MOVC returns exactly reproduces the AEh, matrix-cell and R2 distributions of ADC2=4. Final IRAM69h remains 9Ah in all three; physical ADC2 scale is unverified.

axes.source_G: ACC at 14F0h, after XRAM 6Bh/6Ch and 7Ch arithmetic; physical scale unknown

tables.consumer: G 14F0h -> 5314h/532Fh interpolator -> 5259h multiply; A-family has homologous DPTR load at 153Eh
tables.output: ACC written through @R0 to upper IRAM AEh at G 14FDh; AEh is the row-input byte named by ROM 7B28h and also participates in G 397Dh guard
tables.static_evidence: The nine bytes at 715Ah..7162h and the DPTR load are present in all six ROMs. G 14FBh loads R0=AEh, then 14FDh writes @R0. A-family load is at 153Eh and has the same following R0=AEh write with relocated helper calls.
tables.dynamic_evidence: At G 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, the pre-write probe at 14FDh observed 230 writes. No A-family full boot was exercised.
tables.negative_downstream_evidence: Across those three 2.4M-tick G runs, the 7B46h matrix had the same 918 raw MOVC reads at the same addresses, final IRAM69h remained 9Ah and modeled P5.0 median remained 1861 ticks. Thus AEh changed but no different matrix cells or output timing were observed in this state; fractional interpolation and other states remain open.
tables.segment_crossing_evidence: With natural ADC2=4, AEh=1Dh at G PC330Dh for 95 calls and the 7B46h matrix reads lower cell 7B58h instead of 7B67h; R2=96h instead of 97h at PC3371h in 95 observations. Holding ADC2=100 and adding F2h modulo 256 only to 7100h MOVC return bytes duplicates all three distributions without changing the ROM. The changed lookup result does not alter final IRAM69h=9Ah or P5.0 median in this tested state.
tables.7581_upstream_evidence: In unchanged G code at 1000 RPM, ADC0/3/5/6/7=40/20/40/95/63, supplying S88's 7580h=25h and 7581h MOVC bytes (+15h) changes the dominant upper AEh state from 17h/18h (7580h-only) to 1Fh, matching natural S88 at ADC2=4 and 100. tables.format: 9 raw u8 values, adjacent-pair interpolation

axes.source_G: IRAM[62h]

tables.consumer: G 3C65h loads A=IRAM[62h], DPTR=716Ch and calls 5314h
tables.output: ACC complement bit 7 then upper IRAM CCh; guarded path through C8h, R2 and RAM69h changes modeled P5 timing in G; physical output identity unknown
tables.static_evidence: 3C65h direct DPTR=716Ch and 5314h/532Fh/5333h MOVC path
tables.packed_interpolation_evidence: Original G opcodes at 5314h split ADC2 raw A after SWAP/RR into R5=A&07h and R6=A&F8h; 532Fh interpolates signed adjacent-byte difference times R6/256. Raw ADC2=7Ah/7Bh gives R5=3, R6=D0h/D8h, and ROM716Fh:7170h=86h:80h. The signed difference -6 produces unrounded 81h/80h; 3C6Fh CPL ACC.7 stores upper CCh=01h/00h. tables.format: five adjacent raw u8 control constants
tables.consumer: G uses DPTR=7200h: MOVC at 468Ah/46CAh reads 7265h, 46ABh reads 7266h, 4708h reads 7267h, 46FDh/4724h read 7268h, and 46D7h reads 7269h; A-family homologues are displaced +BDh
tables.output: branches, R5 state and XRAM D9h in the upper-A8h to lower-63h processing route; physical interpretation unresolved
tables.temporal_sweep_evidence: Original G, 1000 RPM, ADC2=400, ADC7=63, ADC3 10-bit 160->180->200->220->200 at ticks 1.2M/1.7M/2.2M/2.7M versus constant-160 control, both stopped at 3.2M. Before the first step, both have identical 73588 MOVC reads and 538 distinct addresses. ROM7266h is first read in the 1.7M-1.8M bucket only in the sweep; IRAM63h changes 28h->2Dh->32h->37h->32h. This is timing evidence in the Fiat emulator, not a temperature calibration. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_coolant_sweep_buckets_follow_adc_steps_in_original_g.
tables.static_evidence: Original opcodes load A=#65h..69h and execute MOVC A,@A+DPTR with DPTR=7200h; all five bytes agree in six ROMs
tables.dynamic_evidence: G full boot at 1000 RPM/ADC7=63: trace records PC468Ah reading 7265h=31h. An accepted ADC3 step from raw 28h to 33h also reaches PC46AB and reads 7266h=1Eh; raw 34h/35h steps take fallback 474Eh before that read. Supplying 50h only as PC468Ah MOVC result at 7265h prevents PC46AB/7266h in the 28h->33h case while raw upper A8h and processed lower 63h remain 33h; original ROM hash is unchanged.
tables.isolated_opcode_evidence: All six original ROMs: starting at G 46E6h or A-family +BDh, R2=22h/R3=20h reads 7268h=03h and publishes IRAM63h=22h without reading 7267h. R2=30h/R3=20h reads 7268h then 7267h=17h, loads R5=17h and publishes IRAM63h=20h. Starting at G 46C6h or A-family +BDh with R3=40h and XRAM D9h=0 reads 7269h=04h and writes XRAM D9h=04h. These states are synthetic and do not prove natural reachability.
tables.two_step_counterfactual_evidence: G and S88 full boots with ADC3 10-bit 160->204 at 1.2M ticks and 204->224 at 1.45M ticks: with original 7266h=1Eh, R5 ends at 1Dh by 3M ticks, only 7265h/7266h are read, and processed IRAM63h ends at 38h. Supplying 01h only as the MOVC result at PC46AB/7266h makes R5 reach zero; 7269h/7268h/7267h are read, R5 reloads 17h, and IRAM63h ends at 32h near 2.05M ticks. Original ROM hashes are unchanged. This is an emulated counterfactual that accelerates the path later reached naturally.
tables.original_long_run_evidence: G and S88 original ROMs, no MOVC override: ADC3 10-bit 160->204 at 1.2M ticks and 204->224 at 1.45M ticks, 1000 RPM/ADC7=63. Both execute 34 writes by PC3286h to decrement XRAM F8D7h in 70M ticks, at nearly identical times; the first is at tick 2047676 G versus 2047691 S88. G lower IRAM63h changes 38h->32h at tick 67584860, with one natural read each at 7269h/7268h/7267h. S88 changes 38h->32h at tick 61440647 and 32h->31h at tick 69633515, with two reads of 7269h and one of 7268h/7267h. The first D7h divergence comes from G PC476Eh restoring a stale R5: PC3286h writes 0Fh->0Eh at tick 32767376, then PC476Eh writes 0Eh->0Fh at tick 32768204; S88 lacks that restoration. Additional G restorations occur later. This explains the observed delay through interleaved writes, though the phase difference and hardware fidelity are unresolved.
tables.counter_decay_consumer: G/S88 original code 327Ah..3290h, A-family identical bytes at 3296h..32ACh: T2CON.1 bypasses both counters; otherwise nonzero XRAM D7h and D9h are each decremented only when lower IRAM 2Dh.4 is set. D7h is subsequently loaded into R5 in the coolant processing block. Isolated original-opcode tests across all six ROMs verify zero, flag-clear and T2CON.1 guards.
open_questions: Determine why G and S88 differ in the phase between coolant processing and D7h decrement, and whether emulated timing matches hardware
Determine whether A-family boot can be modeled without hardware assumptions
Determine whether these values are tunable calibration parameters or fixed control constants

tables.format: 5 rows x 10 raw u8; row stride and row selection are shown by 078Ah..07AEh; last row is all 00h

axes.source_G: low nibble of IRAM[4Eh], incremented if bit 7 is set
row 0/1/2 for 78h selected by 2Fh.5 and T2I1; row 3/4 for 7Ah selected by T2I1

tables.consumer: All six ROMs share identical 0781h..07B5h code with direct DPTR=73E0h and MOVC at 079Ch/07AEh
tables.output: IRAM[78h] and IRAM[7Ah] multiplied by selected u8 factors; G uses 78h at 1D4Bh before IRAM[14h:15h] publication
tables.raw_G_hex: ec ee ef f0 f1 f2 f3 f4 f6 f7 ea ec ee ef f0 f2 f3 f4 f6 f7 ee f0 f2 f3 f3 f4 f5 f6 f7 f7 f3 f3 f5 f7 f8 f9 fa fb fc fc 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
tables.static_evidence: 078Ah derives a low-nibble index from IRAM[4Eh], adds 00h/0Ah/14h for 78h and 1Eh/28h for 7Ah; MUL AB stores the high byte in 78h/7Ah. The entire 0781h..07B5h opcode region is byte-identical across all six ROMs
tables.dynamic_evidence: At 1000 RPM/ADC7=63, ADC3 80->40 changes MOVC factors F3h/F7h at 73F7h/7401h to F2h/F5h at 73F6h/7400h. After correcting emulator opcode 86h, IRAM[78h] stays 00h in the 2.4M-tick G and S88 runs, so this table has no observed nonzero 78h contribution there. An isolated original-ROM test in G/A/S37 with synthetic 78h=7Ah=F3h and 4Eh=23h/B1h gives 78h=E6h/E5h and 7Ah=EAh/E8h. A second synthetic G test swaps 78h=19h/15h at 1D4Bh and changes the intermediate R3:R2 by 0011h/0010h; these are potential path effects, not observed full-run effects. All 230 paired passages from 1DD8h to 1E02h preserve R2:R3 in each G/S88 ROM
tables.adc3_boundary_factor_counterfactual: G/S88 original ROMs, 1000 RPM, ADC2=400/1023, ADC3=160/1023 stepped at tick 800000 to 208/1023, ADC7=63: 079Ch reads 73F4h=EEh 27 times and 07AEh reads 73FEh=F3h 27 times. Supplying 00h at either individual MOVC read leaves lower IRAM78h/7Ah without any observed change from zero, 4Eh=00h, CC3 scheduling median=1160 and modeled P1.3 low width=4629 ticks, identical to the control. Each override was confirmed in the trace and original ROM hashes were preserved. This excludes a contribution from those factor reads via 78h/7Ah in the tested state; it does not exclude other states or other ADC3 paths.
tables.natural_nonzero_input_evidence: An unmodified G boot at 6000 simulated RPM with ADC0/6 40/95 stepped together at tick 800000 to 180/247 naturally writes lower IRAM78h=FFh at PC1C36h. The identical 0781h..07B5h decay code then writes 78h from FFh to EDh at PC07A1h and through later positive values; PC1D4Bh reads those nonzero values. This establishes reachability of this factor consumer in one corrected emulated TPS transient, not a physical unit or output connection.
tables.natural_transient_factor_counterfactual: In the same G TPS-opening transient, original MOVC PC079Ch/73F4h returns EEh in 110 reads and native PC07A1h first changes IRAM78h FFh->EDh. Supplying 00h only as that MOVC return preserves the original ROM/hash and the five native PC1C36h writes of FFh, but PC07A1h first changes FFh->00h; nonzero PC1D4Bh reads drop from 51 to 5 in the logged window. At PC1DD8h near tick 900000, native R3:R2=06C5h while the supplied-factor arm has 044Dh. Overall CC3 input median remains 217 ticks in both arms, modeled complete pulse counts change 133->183, and P5.0 median low width remains 1847. This proves a digital effect of the selected factor cell during a naturally reachable nonzero-78h state, not a physical pin function. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_natural_tps_opening_reaches_ram78_curve_and_consumer.
tables.s88_transient_replication: S88 original ROM under the same 6000-RPM TPS opening also reaches PC1C19h six times with R1=00h/R6=FFh and writes IRAM78h=FFh at PC1C36h. Raw MOVC PC079Ch/73F4h=EEh is read 110 times. Supplying 00h only at that read changes the first PC07A1h update FFh->EDh to FFh->00h and the PC1DD8h pair near tick 900000 from 0793h to 04D0h. The global CC3-input median stays 340 ticks, modeled complete pulse count stays 133, and P5.0 median low width stays 1843 ticks in both arms. S88 firmware SHA-256 remains bfa59928ca41695458063835dc1a05a489b9deb5755bb1d7740c22874fdcbe28. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_s88_tps_opening_73f4_factor_reaches_ram78_consumer; captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_s88_tps_opening_{control,factor_zero}/.
tables.local_factor_sensitivity: At the same natural TPS step, replacing only the PC079Ch/73F4h MOVC result EEh with ECh or F0h changes the first PC07A1h update FFh->EBh or FFh->EFh in both G and S88. R3:R2 at PC1DD8h near tick 900000 is G 06AFh/06C5h/06DFh and S88 077Bh/0793h/07B0h for ECh/EEh/F0h, respectively. Raw ROM/hash stay original in all arms. Global CC3-input medians remain G=217 and S88=340 ticks; modeled P5.0 medians remain G=1847 and S88=1843 ticks. This is a local ordered digital response in one state, not a physical calibration scale. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_factor_{g,s88}_{ec,f0}/; the G/S88 factor tests include these arms.
open_questions: Map the activation envelope and factor response outside this single TPS step/RPM state
Determine the physical scale and output connection of the 78h calculation in each code revision

tables.format: three adjacent 9-byte raw u8 curves, direct DPTR selection and adjacent-byte interpolation

axes.source_G: packed R6 input at 1C19h; 5314h splits it into interpolation index and fraction
2Fh.5 and T2I1 choose 713Fh, 712Dh or 7136h

tables.raw_G_hex: 0d 5a 80 9a b3 cd e6 f3 ff 05 38 6c 8d ae c8 e1 ee ff 48 8d b3 c0 cd e1 f1 ff ff
tables.consumer: G 1C19h tests R6; 1C1Eh/1C24h/1C2Ah select DPTR=712Dh/7136h/713Fh; 1C2Dh calls 5314h and 1C36h conditionally writes lower IRAM78h. A-family has homologous direct DPTR loads at 1C3Ah/1C40h/1C46h.
tables.output: lower IRAM78h, read at G 1D4Bh before CC3 scheduling; no physical output pin established
tables.static_evidence: All six original ROMs contain the same 27 bytes. G original opcodes at 1C19h..1C38h with synthetic R6=00h skip lookup; R6=01h and three controlled flag states select the three original curve addresses and write a positive 78h.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Corrected G full boot, 6000 simulated RPM, ADC0/2/3/5/6/7=180/100/4/40/247/63, 2.4M ticks: supplying 00h only as MOVC PC1A38h/ROM7ADFh return opens PC1BFDh but native R6=00h leaves 78h=00h. Supplying R6=01h only at 1C19h additionally writes 78h at PC1C36h and yields nonzero reads at 1D4Bh; median CC3 input RAM14h:15h changes 1169->1414 ticks, P5.0 low width remains 1847. Supplying 78h=00h only at 1D4Bh restores the CC3 input median to 1169 and the control's complete modeled CC3 pulse count. All arms keep original ROM hash; they are counterfactual and do not prove natural reachability or physical pin identity. The R6=01h arm has only 3 complete modeled CC3 pulses versus 195 in the control, so its low-width median is not a reliable physical comparison.
tables.natural_tps_transient_evidence: Original G ROM and no MOVC/register override, 6000 simulated RPM, ADC0/6 40/95 to 180/247 at tick 800000: PC1C19h sees R1=00h/R6=FFh six times; PC1C36h writes lower IRAM78h=FFh five times. MOVC PC532Fh/5333h reads 7146h/7147h=FFh five times each, with DPTR=713Fh. Initial PC1A38h table returns are positive (7A1Fh=0Bh, 7ADFh=09h); the signed accumulator can clear R1. At PC1D4Bh, 78h is nonzero; at PC1DD8h just after the first write, R3:R2=07A4h. Supplying 78h=00h only at PC1D4Bh in the same TPS transient keeps the original table write but yields R3:R2=044Dh. The overall CC3-input median is 217 ticks in both arms, while complete modeled CC3 pulse counts differ 133/189 and P5.0 low-width median stays 1847 ticks. A reverse TPS step at the same tick gives R6=FFh but R1=03h and does not enter PC1C19h. ROM hash stays original throughout; physical pin identity remains unknown. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_tps_step_{opening,closing,opening_zero_consumer,opening_movc}/.
tables.rpm_tps_envelope_evidence: Original G and S88, ADC0/6 start 40/95 and step jointly at tick 800000 to 120/180 or 180/247, with ADC2/3/5/7=100/4/40/63 and 2.4M modeled ticks. At 1000/3000/6000 RPM, intermediate opening gives five PC1C19h entries with R1=00h and R6 sequence FFh/FCh/B6h/9Ah/7Eh in both ROMs; writes by PC1C36h number 1/2/3 respectively. Full opening gives five/five/six entries with R1=00h and R6=FFh throughout; writes number 2/3/5. All first writes set IRAM78h=FFh. These counts describe tested timing/inputs, not a calibrated throttle threshold. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_envelope_{g,s88}_{1000,3000}_{mid,full}/ and ram78_envelope_{g,s88}_6000_mid plus the 6000-full captures. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_ram78_tps_step_gate_repeats_across_rpm_and_g_s88 covers 1000-mid and 3000-full in both ROMs.
tables.adc10_boundary_evidence: At 1000 simulated RPM with initial ADC0/6=160/380 (10-bit) and paired steps at tick 800000, targets 189/409 keep PC1B34h R1=03h, while 190/410 produce six R1=00h samples, five PC1C19h visits and a PC1C36h write of 78h=97h. Both G and S88 show the boundary. With one channel varied at a time in G, ADC0=190/ADC6=409 keeps IRAM70h=1Dh and IRAM6Ah=D1h and does not enter PC1C19h; ADC0=189/ADC6=410 gives 70h=1Eh, 6Ah=E1h and enters. The relevant writer chain is ADC6->IRAM66h at 0744h, IRAM70h at 11D1h, pointer 7058h->7970h at 125Ah, IRAM6Ah at 125Eh, then 19DEh..1A38h and the 5419h accumulator. The 189/409 versus 190/410 threshold is specific to this initial state and emulated ADC quantization; isolated mismatched inputs are diagnostic, not physically validated TPS voltages. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_ram78_tps_adc10_boundary_follows_channel6_in_tested_state.
open_questions: Test whether the ADC6 409/410 boundary moves with other initial TPS, RPM and sensor states
Identify which signed sample clears R1 during the natural opening
Isolate the 713Fh cell effect during the native transient
Test A-family consumer under its validated hardware profile

tables.format: 10 raw u8 values used by adjacent-byte interpolation at 5329h

axes.source_G: R5/R6 from 5639h; selects XRAM F8:91h under 28h/29h flags and nonzero F8:9Eh, otherwise IRAM4Eh

tables.consumer: Fiat G 129Dh calls 5639h; 12CFh selects pointer 7004h->7412h, 12D2h calls 5329h, and 12D5h/12D7h write R2 into lower IRAM4Ah/4Bh
tables.output: IRAM4Ah/4Bh; 15ABh..15C3h reads both and combines one with a 706Ah-derived factor. Physical function and scale unknown.
tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs preserve big-endian 7004h->7412h and the same ten table bytes. The G 129Dh caller obtains R5/R6 from 5639h before 5329h interpolation.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Original G 1000 RPM, ADC2=220, ADC3=232, ADC7=63: supplying F891=14h only at PC564Ah when stack return is 12A0h changes R6=30h->10h, stable upper IRAM87h=5Bh->5Ah and IRAM4Ah/4Bh=91h->8Ah at PC12D9h; CC3-input median changes 1505->1491 ticks. A reverse F891 supply of 34h with ROM73C6h read replaced 0Fh->1Fh restores 5Bh, 91h and 1505 ticks. This shows co-propagation through two tables, not which output mediates CC3.
tables.isolated_curve_evidence: At original G F891=34h, supplying 98h instead of BEh only for MOVC PC5333h/741Bh changes stable IRAM4Ah/4Bh 91h->8Ah while upper IRAM87h stays 5Bh and the CC3-input median stays 1505 ticks. Thus this cell and output do not mediate the tested F891-to-CC3 difference; other states may differ.
open_questions: Trace other consumers and operating states of IRAM4Ah/4Bh
Validate consumer and behavior in A-family hardware profile

tables.format: ten raw u8 cells; adjacent-pair interpolation, with no global index bound proven

axes.source: R5/R6 from the 5639h packed-index selector in G

tables.consumer: G 15D5h loads big-endian pointer 7006h and 15D8h calls interpolator 5329h; A-family 161Ch/161Fh calls homologous 53ECh. The preceding JB 2Fh.0 skips this lookup when the bit is 1, so the lookup executes with 2Fh.0=0
tables.output: interpolated R2, immediately multiplied by R3 at 15DBh..15DFh; later physical effect not isolated
tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs have 7006h->741Ch and ten identical 40h bytes. G 15D2h calls the packed-index selector before interpolation; A-family 1619h calls the homologous selector. Both branches skip the lookup if 2Fh.0=1.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Isolated original opcodes from all six ROMs read 741Ch/741Dh with R5=0 and 7424h/7425h with R5=8, returning R2=40h at R6=80h. With synthetic R5=9 the second MOVC reads 7426h, the first byte of the next region. This boundary test does not establish that R5=9 occurs naturally.
tables.natural_G_observation: Three original G 2.4M-tick traces with immediate 60-2 input and no K-Line read the 741Ch curve: 1000 RPM ADC0/6=40/95 or 180/247, ADC3=80 had 21 lookup pairs each, with first indices 00h and 03h and effective addresses 741Ch/741Dh and 741Fh/7420h. At 4000 RPM, ADC0/6=180/247 and ADC3=4, there were 11 pairs, all at 741Ch/741Dh. No read exceeded 7425h in these runs. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/constant_741c_*/. This is an observed range, not a global bound.

Trace the R2 product to downstream RAM and modeled pins

tables.format: 10 raw u8 values used by 5329h interpolation

axes.source_G: R5/R6 from 5639h; IRAM4Eh or, under fault flags and nonzero F8:9Eh, XRAM F8:91h
axes.physical_G: coolant-derived candidate for IRAM4Eh path only

tables.consumer: G 12C3h loads pointer 7008h and 12C6h calls 5329h
tables.output: R2 is written to upper IRAM[87h] at 12CCh; 155Ah multiplies it by a value from pointer 70D8h, and only a product without OV clears 2Eh.2
tables.static_evidence: 7008h holds big-endian 7426h; G 12BEh calls 5329h and stores R2 via @R0=87h. A uses the same 12BEh consumer with relocated helpers 53ECh and 56FCh and a homologous 1588h..15B0h gate
tables.dynamic_evidence: With corrected emulator opcode 86h, at G 1000 RPM/ADC7=63 and ADC3=80 the first periodic 155Ah multiplication uses upper 87h=1Bh and A=EEh, giving 191Ah and OV=1. Upper 87h decays to 01h by 20.5M ticks, then 2Eh.2 clears; another guard still prevents 186Dh in the tested 24M ticks. ADC3=4 gives upper 87h=00h, clears 2Eh.2 and permits visits to 186Dh and ADC5-dependent changes in F8:0Ch. Isolated execution of G and A at 12BEh gives A's upper 87h output 10h higher for identical 4Eh-derived indices 33h and C1h; at synthetic index 20h, G outputs 00h and A outputs at least 02h, changing the homologous overflow guard outcome
tables.code_vs_calibration_evidence: The original 12BEh consumer was executed at identical IRAM4Eh indices 20h,33h,C1h in all six ROMs. A and A+ use the raised 7426h bytes and produce the same upper IRAM87h; G and S88 use the lower bytes and produce the same output. S37/S36 use the A-family code revision but G's lower 7426h bytes and also match G's 87h output at each tested index. At index 20h the homologous overflow guard preserves 2Eh.2 only in A/A+, whereas G/S88/S37/S36 clear it. Thus the tested difference follows calibration bytes across code revisions in this isolated state; full-boot A-family behavior remains unverified.
tables.cc3_mediation_evidence: Original G at 1000 RPM, ADC2=220, ADC3=232, ADC7=63, F891=34h: supplying 5Ah instead of 60h only at MOVC PC5333h/742Fh lowers stable upper IRAM87h 5Bh->5Ah, leaves IRAM4Ah/4Bh=91h and changes CC3-input median 1505->1491 ticks and modeled CC3 low width 6009->5953 ticks. A separate 741Bh override changes IRAM4Ah/4Bh to 8Ah with IRAM87h and CC3 unchanged. With F891 read at PC564Ah/return12A0h supplied as 14h, supplying 6Ah at PC5333h/742Fh restores upper IRAM87h 5Ah->5Bh and CC3 medians 1491->1505 and 5953->6009, while IRAM4Ah/4Bh remain 8Ah. This bidirectional curve-cell experiment supports mediation by the 7426h interpolation output in this emulated G state, not physical actuator identity.
tables.downstream_chain_evidence: Static G 1562h consumes upper IRAM87h, 1644h stores R3:R2 in lower IRAM59h:5Ah, 1D60h reads that pair, and 1ED3h stores R3:R2 in lower IRAM14h:15h for CC3 scheduling at 058Eh. In 2.4M-tick G traces, substituting only MOVC PC5333h/742Fh 60h->5Ah changes modal 1D4Bh-input IRAM5Ah 9Dh->8Fh (99 passages), PC1DD8h R2 9Dh->8Fh (100 passages), and PC1ED3h R2 E1h->D3h (100 passages); CC3-input median changes 1505->1491 ticks. The separate 741Bh output intervention and 742Fh rescue keep these downstream modal values aligned with upper IRAM87h. This supports a digital calibration-to-scheduler chain under one emulated G condition, not physical actuator or time scale.
tables.S88_replication_evidence: Original S88 ROM has the same 7008h->7426h pointer and ten curve bytes as G. At 1000 RPM, ADC2=220, ADC3=232, supplying 5Ah only at MOVC PC5333h/742Fh changes stable upper IRAM87h 5Bh->5Ah, modal PC1DD8h R2 51h->44h, CC3-input median 1429->1416 ticks and modeled CC3 low width 5705->5653 ticks. Supplying F891=14h only at PC564Ah/return12A0h reproduces these values; adding a 6Ah supply at PC5333h/742Fh restores 5Bh, 51h, 1429 and 5705 while IRAM4Ah/4Bh stay 8Ah. This reproduces digital mediation in a second original ROM, not a physical output identification.
tables.A_cell_donor_evidence: A/A+ have 6Ah/70h at 742Eh/742Fh versus 5Ah/60h in G/S88. Supplying only the two A values at original MOVC PCs 532Fh/5333h to unmodified G and S88 at 1000 RPM, ADC2=220, ADC3=232 leaves R5:R6=08h:30h and IRAM4Ah=91h, but changes stable upper IRAM87h 5Bh->6Bh. G modal PC1DD8h R2 changes 9Dh->F1h, CC3-input median 1505->1589 ticks and modeled CC3 low width 6009->6345. S88 changes 51h->A0h, 1429->1508 and 5705->6021. Original ROM hashes and raw MOVC values remain unchanged. This supports a calibration-cell effect in the two recipient ROMs under this fault-bound ADC state, not natural runtime behavior of A or physical output identity.
tables.A_cells_clear_fault_evidence: At 1000 RPM, ADC2=220 and ADC3=80, observed PC477Fh samples in G and S88 have lower IRAM28h=00h and IRAM63h=50h. The PC129Dh selector uses R5:R6=03h:20h and reads 7429h/742Ah=1Ah/1Dh; A/A+ carry 2Ah/2Dh there. Supplying only these two A values at PC532Fh/5333h changes upper IRAM87h 1Ah->2Ah with lower IRAM4Ah=0Fh unchanged. G modal PC1DD8h R2 changes 1Bh->6Fh, CC3-input median 863->947 ticks and modeled low width 3441->3777; S88 changes F1h->40h, 821->900 and 3273->3589. Original G/S88 ROM hashes remain unchanged. This demonstrates a calibration-cell effect without the observed IRAM28h fault flags in this modeled state, not a physical actuator identity or natural A-family runtime effect.
tables.rpm_replication_evidence: At ADC2=220, ADC3=80, ADC7=63 and IRAM28h=00h observed at PC477Fh, G/S88 use R5:R6=03h:20h and read 7429h/742Ah 17 times each at 750 RPM and 13 each at 1500 RPM. Supplying the A/A+ pair 2Ah/2Dh changes stable upper IRAM87h 1Ah->2Ah. G CC3-input medians at 750/1500 RPM change 1044->1146 and 644->704 ticks; modeled CC3 low widths 4165->4573 and 2565->2804. S88 medians change 900->987 and 721->788; low widths 3589->3937 and 2873->3141. Original ROM hashes remain unchanged. This extends the digital calibration effect across three RPM states, not physical actuator identification.
tables.high_rpm_replication_evidence: With the same ADC state at 2000/3000/4000 RPM, original G and S88 still read 7429h/742Ah 12/11/10 times each; PC477Fh samples have IRAM28h=00h and PC12D9h uses R5:R6=03h:20h. Supplying only A/A+ 2Ah/2Dh changes stable upper IRAM87h 1Ah->2Ah while lower IRAM4Ah stays 0Fh. G CC3-input medians change 534->582, 399->434, 337->365 ticks; modeled low widths change 2124->2316, 1584->1724, 1325->1437. S88 changes 633->691, 536->585, 515->561 and modeled lows 2520->2752, 2133->2328, 2025->2209. Original ROM hashes are unchanged. The same fault flags and nonzero 9Eh then select PC490Bh/4912h; MOVC reads ROM727Fh=2Eh 511 times, while PC491Fh and every 7430h..7461h curve cell are absent. Thus natural XRAM91h reachability is confirmed in these modeled boundary states, but it does not establish XRAM91h as the active axis of 744Eh.
tables.donor_evidence: A pointer-verified 10-byte MOVC donor from original A into active original G, 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3=20, ADC5=40, ADC7=63, 5M ticks, changes lower IRAM4Dh at PC49ADh from 19h to 2Fh; identical S88 donor leaves it at 19h. The G ROM hash and raw MOVC values remain original. At PC2320h R2 equals 4Dh and A equals RAM49h in all 484 pairs per scenario; PC233Bh R2 matches min(BAh,R2+floor(A*R2/128)) in all 968 pairs. First post-1M R2 changes 2Dh->56h and reaches PC2580h with P2=F8h,R1=42h. P5.0 median low width stays 1861 ticks and raw CC3 input median stays 625.5 ticks in these scenarios. This confirms an internal table effect, not an actuator or physical role.
tables.xram_36_37_evidence: Optional MOVX write trace found the same ordered 492 value changes at F836h/F837h in G control and A-donor runs; source PCs also match. Only small write-tick differences occurred. No changed XRAM value at these addresses is established in this state.
tables.rpm3000_read_crossover_evidence: Original G at 3000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, 2.4M ticks: A's ten 744Eh MOVC values donated into G change lower IRAM4Dh 19h->2Fh and modeled CC3/P1.3 low-start count 103->228, median low width 1129->1150 ticks. Supplying 2Fh only to original G MOV R2,4Dh at PC22F3h reproduces 228/1150; supplying 19h at that read in the A-donor arm restores 103/1129. Control and 19h-crossover read ROM7310h 123 times, donor and 2Fh-crossover zero times. Decision trace shows control IRAM26h.7 rising by tick 1156306 and suppressing subsequent CC3 edges, whereas donor keeps it clear in sampled decisions. Matched edge times differ at most two ticks. Active ROM/hash remains G in all four arms; P5 median stays 1768 ticks. This establishes digital mediation through the RAM4Dh read and branch reachability in this state, not physical injector identity, a coolant scale, or the physical cut-off threshold. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/post_coolant_744e_3000_{control,donor_a,control_r2_2f,donor_r2_19}/ and post_coolant_744e_3000_decision_{control,donor_a}/.
tables.rpm_sweep_744e_branch_evidence: Matched G control/A-MOVC-donor runs with ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=20/40/63 and 2.4M ticks give modeled CC3 pulse counts and ROM7310h reads: at 1500 RPM 51/51 pulses and 121/121 reads; 2000 RPM 68/68 and 122/122; 2500 RPM 86/118 and 122/85; 3000 RPM 103/228 and 123/0. The A donor acts only on the ten 744Eh MOVC returns, leaving G ROM/hash intact. This is a state-dependent digital effect, with transition location, physical output and physical cut-off threshold unverified. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/post_coolant_744e_{1500,2000,2500,3000}_{control,donor_a}/.
tables.xram31_branch_evidence: In original G at 3000 RPM and fixed ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, PC2796h writes F8:31h as 07h->36h->54h; A 744Eh MOVC donor yields 07h->60h->7Eh. Crossovers of the single lower IRAM4Dh read at PC22F3h swap these F8:31h values. Original PC2A8Ch reads F8:31h; at PC2A91h near tick 266k, control computes 76h-54h=22h with CY=0 and donor computes 76h-7Eh=F8h with CY=1, taking JC 2A45h. Supplying 7Eh only at the control PC2A8Ch/F831h read reproduces donor behavior: 228 modeled CC3 pulses, zero ROM7310h reads and no PC2C49h. Supplying 36h at the same read in the donor restores 103 pulses, 123 ROM7310h reads and PC2C49h. Changing the distinct F831h reader PC33A9h did not swap these outcomes. This proves digital mediation through the PC2A8Ch comparison in this state; it does not identify CC3 wiring or the curve's physical units. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_744e_f831_comparison_changes_branch_reachability; captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/post_coolant_744e_3000_{xram31_*,branch_*}/.
tables.flag_transition_evidence: In the same 3000-RPM G control, PC2B42h is reached once at tick 1146773 with lower IRAM24h=8Eh and 27h=04h; original opcodes set 27h.3 and 24h.5. PC2C49h is first reached at tick 1146823 with 24h=AAh and 27h=0Eh, then ROM7310h is read. With the 744Eh A donor neither PC occurs within 2.4M ticks; both occur later in the 5M-tick trace. Supplying F8:31h=7Eh only at PC2A8Ch to control removes both within 2.4M ticks; supplying 36h at that read to donor restores both within that window. Control PC2B38h reads F8:39h=2Eh after writes 20h->2Fh->2Eh at ticks 1146722/1146760, permitting ACC.6=0 and ACC.5=1 into PC2B42h. Donor never visits PC2B38h within 2.4M ticks and F8:39h stays 0Fh until after tick 2.2M; this state contrast does not isolate F8:39h as an independent cause. This connects the F8:31h comparison to the flags gating 2C49h in the modeled state. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/post_coolant_744e_3000_{flags,xram39}_{control,donor_a}/; test: VariantTraceTests.test_744e_f831_comparison_changes_branch_reachability.
tables.long_horizon_delay_evidence: Extending matched G control and A-744Eh MOVC-donor boots at 3000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=20/40/63 to 5M ticks shows a delay rather than permanent suppression. First PC2AC7h ticks 317153/2344920, PC2AF9h 839577/2866953, PC2B42h 1146773/3174451 and PC2C49h 1146823/3174501; stage delays span only 391 ticks around 2.028M, about 2.05 s at the Fiat harness 990000 ticks/s. IRAM26h.7 first observed set at ticks 1156306/3183656; last modeled CC3 edges at 1155750/3175552. At 5M ticks the arms have 103/307 modeled CC3 pulses and 377/179 ROM7310h reads. Thus the donor delays the digital guard in this state; the earlier zero-read result applies only to the first 2.4M ticks. Physical injector identity and cut-off timing remain unverified. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/post_coolant_744e_3000_long_{control,donor_a}/.
tables.f831_threshold_crossing_evidence: At 3000 RPM and the same fixed ADC inputs, G writes F8:31h=54h at PC2796h/tick 265886, then PC2A91h first has CY=0 after tick 265000 at tick 266070 with 76h-54h=22h. The A-744Eh MOVC donor writes F8:31h=76h at tick 2201240 after descending from 7Eh, then PC2A91h first has CY=0 at tick 2201429 with 76h-76h=00h. These events precede the first PC2AC7h by 51083/143491 ticks respectively. The later difference is explained by a restart of the F8:39h low-nibble counter; see xram39_countdown_evidence. tables.xram39_countdown_evidence: Original G code 550Dh..5570h called at 2AB3h updates the low nibble of XRAM F8:39h and returns it in A; 2AB7h continues only when A=0. At 3000 RPM both control and A-744Eh donor initially count F839h from 0Fh to 06h. Donor PC2A91h borrow routes to 2A45h, whose PC2A4Bh write resets F839h 06h->0Fh at tick 266076; G PC555Bh instead continues 06h->05h at tick 266120. After F831h drops to 76h, donor PC555Bh resumes 0Fh->0Eh at tick 2201473. The first PC2AB7h A=0 occurs at ticks 317141/2344908, followed by PC2AC7h. tables.single_first_cell_delay_evidence: At 3000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, supplying only A's ROM744Eh byte 2Fh at original G PC532Fh reproduces the full ten-byte donor's 5M-tick digital delay: both have 307 modeled CC3 pulses and 179 ROM7310h reads, with all 614 paired CC3 edges at the same levels and within two ticks. tables.consumer: G/S88 4901h..4914h and A/A+/S37/S36 49BEh..49D1h: when any 28h.3/.4/.5 or 29h.3 is set and XRAM 9Eh is nonzero, MOVC A,@A+DPTR with A=7Fh loads 727Fh into R2 instead of selecting 7018h/701Eh curve

tables.static_evidence: ROM727Fh=2Eh in all six images. The G 4901h..4913h instruction prefix matches the A-family 49BEh..49D0h; the following SJMP displacement differs with the revision layout.
tables.dynamic_evidence: Two original G full boots at 1000 RPM with ADC2=220 and raw ADC3=03h/E8h each read 727Fh=2Eh at PC4912h 511 times in 2.4M ticks. Both bypass 491Fh and read no 7430h..7461h cell. Original ROM hashes are unchanged.
tables.counterfactual_evidence: In the raw-ADC3=E8h G state, a four-arm test supplies no MOVC override, the original 2Eh as sham, 00h or 80h only at PC4912h/ROM727Fh. Raw MOVC records still show 2Eh and the ROM hash is fixed. The first 49ADh write to lower 4Dh becomes 2Eh/2Eh/19h/80h; ROM7279h=19h and the P4.7-gated 4951h path explain the 00h floor. In 229 steady visits per arm to PC233Bh, R2 becomes 45h/45h/25h/BAh and reaches PC2580h. The CC3 input median remains 1505 ticks and P5.0 median low width 1861 ticks in all four arms. This isolates an internal effect of the fallback byte, without physical output attribution.

tables.format: 10 raw u8 values, adjacent-pair interpolation

axes.source: R5 index and R6 fraction at the lookup; upstream provenance not fully traced

tables.consumer: A/A+/S37/S36 49D3h..49E5h when T2CON.1=0 and 2Bh.7=1; G/S88 4916h has no corresponding 2Bh.7 branch
tables.output: R2, then B and the conditional calculation ending at the A-code homologue of G 49ADh; physical function unknown
tables.evidence: Original A-code at 49D3h uses 2Bh.7 to choose pointer 701Ah instead of 7018h while T2CON.1=0. Isolated R5=3,R6=0 execution reaches MOVC with DPTR=7458h and returns 4Dh in A/A+ versus 33h in S37/S36. Within each A-family ROM, the ten bytes at 7458h equal the ten at 744Eh. The original 53E4h interpolation code loads DPTR=7200h after reading the curve; a paired isolated original-ROM test with R5=9,R6=0 and XRAM[6Ch]=B0h confirms equal lower-IRAM 4Dh outputs for the two pointer choices: 99h in A and 7Fh in S37. This does not establish equal behavior in every ECU state or natural use of 2Bh.7. G's own 7458h differs and is not selected by its G code path.
tables.index9_boundary_evidence: The adjacent-pair reader also fetches base+R5+1. At prepared R5=9,R6=80h, this reaches beyond the ten cataloged cells: A has 7458h=2Fh versus 7462h=2Dh, and S37 has 7458h=15h versus 7462h=13h. Original A/S37 code returns R2=5Bh/5Ah and 41h/40h for 7018h/701Ah selection respectively; in this isolated state lower IRAM4Dh receives the same respective values. R5=9 with a nonzero fraction has not been observed on a natural A-family path, so this is a conditional boundary effect, not a demonstrated mode difference in operation.
tables.producer_boundary_evidence: Exhaustive isolated original-opcode sweeps of all 256 raw lower IRAM63h values in each A/A+/S37/S36 ROM reach PC483Ch after the 7002h->73D4h segment decoder. R5 never exceeds 9, and every R5=9 result has R6=0; index 8 does occur with nonzero R6. Separate 256-value sweeps of lower IRAM62h at PC46B6h..46C6h exercise the 708Eh->73C0h air segment and F8:91h writer: R5 never exceeds 5, and every R5=5 result has R6=0, so this writer does not encode a terminal low nibble with a nonzero high-nibble fraction. These two local producers do not generate the demonstrated index-9 boundary difference. Other XRAM91 writers, state-dependent guards and a natural A-family boot remain outside these sweeps.
tables.boot_f891_evidence: The six-ROM original-code boot test observes F8:91h=AAh at PC0A3Ah after the XRAM self-test and F8:91h=00h at PC0B30h after startup clearing. This distinguishes transient self-test contents from the later 46B6h..46C6h control writer; it does not prove absence of another runtime writer or a natural A-family curve-bank selection.
tables.natural_boundary_lookahead: The override-free G/S88 MOVC corpus has 4088 effective reads at 7458h, all with DPTR=744Eh and PC5333h: the preceding 744Eh curve reads its next cell. No DPTR=7458h base read appears in the inspected corpus. The current-emulator ADC3=220 controls reproduce 582/581 of those lookahead reads. This does not establish natural A-family 2Bh.7 selection or a functional effect of the 7458h byte.

Determine whether duplicate curve bytes represent mode aliases

tables.downstream_evidence: G/S88/S37/S36 table index 3 gives 79h=80h; A/A+ gives A2h. With ACC=80h and XRAM[00h]=XRAM[02h]=80h, original identical multiplier opcodes yield B=10h versus 15h in all six ROMs. Later output remains unverified.
tables.natural_G_S88_evidence: At 1000 RPM, ADC3=4, ADC5=40 and ADC7=63, G and S88 full boots over 2.4M ticks naturally select DPTR=750Ch and read 750Ch=53h and 750Dh=5Dh at PCs 532Fh/5333h, at least 280 pairs. Supplying only the original A byte 75h at the 532Fh/750Ch read while retaining each active ROM changes final IRAM79h to 75h and downstream B at injection input 1D4Bh from 14h to 1Ch after tick 1.3M. tables.conditional_ram78_gate: With RAM78h=80h supplied only at the original 1D4Bh read, the same G/S88 full-boot ADC state and original ROMs produce final 79h=53h/75h from native/A-donor 750Ch cells. CC3 scheduling median changes 1491->1591 ticks in G and 1493->1591 in S88; modeled P1.3 low width changes 5934.5->6347 and 5938.5->6346.5 ticks respectively. P5.0 median stays 1861 (G) or 1921 (S88) within each pair. This proves conditional table-to-output behavior in the emulator; RAM78h=80h has not been observed naturally in this hardware profile and P1.3 physical wiring remains unverified.
tables.extended_G_S88_observation: G at 6M ticks and ADC5=40 repeats 79h=53h->75h and B=14h->1Ch while CC3 and P5 medians remain unchanged. At ADC5=200, repeated G control/donor traces give CC3 medians 513->520.5 ticks and P1.3 low widths 2040.5->2070.5; S88 gives CC3 522->520 and P1.3 2076.5->2068.5. RAM78h remains zero at the sampled 1D4Bh entries and P5.0 median is unchanged within each pair. Opposite signs and the zero gate prevent attributing these small timing changes to the 79h multiplication path.

tables.conditional_output_evidence: At G/S88 1000 RPM with original ROMs and forced IRAM78h=80h only at consumer PC1D4Bh, replacing the MOVC return at PC532Fh/ROM7523h from 93h with B5h changes interpolated 79h=95h to B2h. tables.natural_gate_survey: Five original G 1.6M-tick traces varied TPS ADC0/ADC6, coolant ADC3 and RPM. At PC1B34h, R1 was 03h or 09h and R7 was 04h or FFh; all visits continued through 1B48h, bits 21h.0/.1 remained clear and 78h stayed zero. The five 48-byte pointer targets at 70E0h..70E8h contain no zero in any of the six ROMs. Two new G 2.4M-tick high-TPS ADC0/6=180/247, ADC3=4 runs at RPM 300/6000 read only in-range indices 00h/2Ah and 00h/2Ah/2Fh respectively at MOVC PC1A38h; returned bytes were 03h/09h and 03h/09h/0Bh. RAM78h stayed zero; at 300 RPM the 1B34h guard was not entered, while at 6000 it led to 1B48h. This does not establish a global bound for R4 or all operating modes.
tables.r1_gate_refinement: The six-ROM 70DEh header gives B=06h and R3 in 0..5 for every tested IRAM47h byte. The G 19DEh..19FAh arithmetic therefore bounds R4 to 15*6+5=95; each selected pointer's 96-byte effective read window is nonzero in all six ROMs, including reads beyond its nominal 48-byte block. However the original signed accumulator at G 5419h/A 54DCh can clear an initially nonzero R1 when a nonnegative accumulated sample reaches that threshold. Isolated original-opcode controls A=02h/03h with initial R1=03h confirm retained/cleared R1 in all six ROMs. Those earlier steady traces did not show R1=0; the later TPS-step trace does.
tables.natural_r1_phase_observation: With MA17_TRACE_RAM78_GATE=1, original G 2.4M-tick 1000 RPM ADC0/6=40/95 ADC3=80 has 230 samples of initial R1=03h at PC1A3Ah and 209 samples of later R1=03h at PC1B34h. At 6000 RPM ADC0/6=180/247 ADC3=4 there are 231 initial samples with R1=03h/09h/0Bh and 221 later samples with R1=09h/0Bh. Neither trace observes R1=00h at either PC. The probes sample separate phases; unequal counts do not imply paired state changes. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_gate_r1_{baseline1000,high6000}/.
tables.r1_gate_movc_counterfactual: At original G 6000 RPM, ADC0/6=180/247, ADC3=4, ADC5=40 and 2.4M ticks, supplying 00h only for PC1A38h/ROM7ADAh (native 09h; 10 reads) creates initial R1=00h at PC1A3Ah but no zero at PC1B34h and no PC1BFDh entry. Supplying 00h at ROM7ADFh (native 09h; 104 reads) or ROM7A1Fh (native 0Bh; 115 reads) creates R1=00h at PC1B34h and reaches PC1BFDh 106 or 116 times. Every recorded PC1BFDh visit has R6=00h; RAM78h remains 00h and CC3-input median, modeled CC3 low width and P5.0 low-width median match the control in all four arms. The original ROM hash and raw MOVC records are preserved. This establishes a conditional path to the gate in the emulator, not natural R1=0 reachability or a physical actuator role. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_gate_7ada_*/.
tables.natural_tps_donor_evidence: A later G/S88 TPS-opening step at 6000 simulated RPM naturally sets IRAM78h nonzero. Original MOVC PC532Fh/7520h reads 4Dh and PC47BEh writes IRAM79h=4Dh. Supplying A-family ROM[7520h]=6Fh only at that MOVC changes 79h to 6Fh while original raw ROM/hash remain intact. At PC1DD8h near tick 900000, G R3:R2 changes 06C5h->07DCh and S88 changes 0793h->08CCh. Forcing IRAM78h=00h only at its PC1D4Bh consumer makes both native and donated arms give 044Dh in G and 04D0h in S88, despite the 79h difference. Global CC3-input medians remain 217/340 ticks for G/S88 and modeled P5.0 low widths 1847/1843 across each four-arm contrast. This confirms a natural emulated 7520h-to-79h-to-78h-dependent intermediate calculation, not a measured injector or pin function. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_7520_donor_needs_natural_ram78_at_1d4b; captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_7520_{donor_g,donor_s88,donor_zero_g,donor_zero_s88,control_zero_s88}/ plus opening controls.
tables.natural_tps_local_cc3_evidence: At 3000 RPM with the same natural ADC0/6 step at tick 800000, G original ROM[7520h]=4Dh versus donor MOVC return 6Fh changes the PC058Eh CC3 input at instruction 907094 from 07FAh to 0947h and the modeled P1.3/CC3 low pulse beginning tick 907122 from 8156 to 9488 ticks. S88 repeats the contrast: 08F0h to 0A67h at PC058Eh and 9140 to 9885 modeled low ticks. Forcing IRAM78h=00h only at PC1D4Bh in G makes both native and donor arms 0506h at PC058Eh and 5132 low ticks. The full-run CC3-input medians remain 1424 (G) and 1592.5 (S88), so those aggregates hide the local effect. At 6000 RPM the altered CC3 inputs reach PC058Eh but modeled low widths around tick 900000 stay near 4935 of the 4950-tick half-cycle. These are emulated pin-model timings, not physical injector identification. Captures: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ram78_7520_3000_*; test: VariantTraceTests.test_7520_donor_changes_local_cc3_pulse_via_ram78_at_3000_rpm.

tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs have 70A8h->7B28h and identical axis bytes. In the G/S88 5279h helper, first lookup reads last increment AFh at PC5289h; AEh>=51h makes AFh+AEh carry and returns R4=0 at the high end. G/S88 5342h CJNE R4,#00h then bypasses MOVC at 534Bh/5350h when zero.
tables.dynamic_evidence: At 2000 RPM and raw ADC0/2/3/5/6/7=180/220/40/40/247/63, G has dominant upper AEh=4Dh, R4=90h, and matrix MOVC 532Fh/5333h/534Bh/5350h counts 230/230/229/229. S88 has upper AEh=57h, R4=00h, counts 230/230/12/12. Supplying only PC5289h/7B31h MOVC return A8h in S88 leaves its ROM intact, changes dominant R4 to E0h and second-pair counts to 229/229; modeled P5.0 median remains 1818 ticks. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/7cae_interpolator_axis/.
tables.paired_1000rpm_interpolator_evidence: At 1000 RPM, raw ADC0..7=100/130/100/20/90/40/155/63 and 1.2M ticks, G has dominant upper AEh/R4=33h/00h and 20 second-pair reads at each PC534Bh/5350h; S88 has 31h/C0h and 112 each. With original G ROM active, S88 7580h alone gives 29h/00h and S88 7581h matrix alone gives 3Ah/00h; both returns jointly give 31h/C0h and 112 reads, matching S88 selector state. Ten reached S88 7B46h cells then make final IRAM69h=93h and modeled CC3 median 3405 ticks, matching S88. Supplying S88 7B45h=0Dh additionally makes output_latches, cc3_observation, engine_ram_observation and pc_coverage objects equal to S88 in this window. The 12M-tick original-ROM pair has 20 versus 1166 second-pair reads per PC in G versus S88. Physical output and global equivalence remain unverified. tables.upstream_factorial: At the same 2000 RPM/raw ADC state, original G and S88 execute identical 14D9h..14FDh code and have identical 7100h and 715Ah..7162h bytes. At PC14FDh, the last 200 writes have RAM7Ch=8Eh in all five runs. G native, G with only S88 7580h=25h MOVC return, G with only S88 7581h 225-byte MOVC donor, G with both, and S88 native produce upper AEh=4Dh/4Eh/55h/57h/57h; corresponding R4 at PC3356h is 90h/B0h/00h/00h/00h. Each run has 230/230 first-pair 7B46h MOVC reads and 229/229 or 12/12 second-pair reads according to R4. The combined G interventions reproduce the S88 selected state while the active G ROM SHA remains unchanged. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/ae_source_2000/; test: VariantTraceTests.test_7580_and_7581_jointly_explain_s88_upper_ae_at_2000rpm. tables.downstream_triad_at_2000rpm: At the same state, adding S88 returns only for the eight actually read 7B46h cells to the G 7580h+7581h interventions retains AEh=57h and R4=00h. CC3 median is 6377 ticks for G with all three interventions versus 6376 for S88; IRAM14h:15h median is 1597 in both. Active G ROM SHA remains original. tables.dynamic_evidence: Natural G/S88 boot trace reads 7B46h/7B47h once via 532Fh/5333h: 99h/99h in G versus A1h/A1h in S88. Isolated original-ROM test with IRAM[57h]=0 selects the same addresses. All 120 S88 cells are G+8 modulo 256
tables.last_column_boundary_read: S88 original at 6000 RPM, ADC3/5/7=4/40/63 and ADC0/6=40/95->180/247 at tick 800000 reads 7BBDh at PC534Bh and then 7BBEh at PC5350h once, with DPTR still 7B46h. Thus 7BBEh is a one-past read of this matrix, not proof that the next 7BBEh matrix was selected. At PC3356h R5=68h and R6=00h; 527Ch..52CCh forces zero fraction at segment index 0Eh. Supplying A0h rather than native A1h for the extra read leaves structured RAM/P5/CC3/lookup and PC coverage identical. tables.clean_tps_donor_evidence: At 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3=20, ADC5=40 and 4M ticks, pointer-verified donation of S88 7B46h..7BBDh into unchanged G changes final IRAM69h 9Ah->A2h. tables.timer1_path_evidence: The same 7B46h donation changes final IRAM34h:35h from 8BFFh to A8FFh and IRAM32h:33h from 12FEh to 2FFEh. The two 29-tick shifts cancel, leaving the 1861-tick median width. A direct IRAM69h read override in G reproduces the changed 34h value; forcing 9Ah with the donor restores it. Selected lookup, CC3 and PC-coverage summaries match, but P5 width histograms and some RAM histories differ; full ECU equivalence is not established.
